title: SQL 高级实战
description: SQL 高级：窗口函数、CTE、透视、性能优化、事务与锁、存储过程与触发器

content.content: SELECT user_id, amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY amount DESC) AS rn FROM orders;
SELECT name, score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) AS rk FROM exams;
SELECT name, score, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) AS rk FROM exams;

content.tips: 每组 Top N 查询
content.content: SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY price DESC) AS rn FROM products) t WHERE t.rn <= 3;
SELECT id, amount, SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS running_total FROM orders;
SELECT id, amount, AVG(amount) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma3 FROM orders;
SELECT id, amount, LAG(amount, 1) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS prev_amount FROM orders;
SELECT id, amount, LEAD(amount, 1) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS next_amount FROM orders;
SELECT name, score, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) AS quartile FROM exams;
WITH high_value AS (SELECT user_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM orders GROUP BY user_id HAVING total > 1000) SELECT u.name, h.total FROM users u JOIN high_value h ON u.id = h.user_id;
WITH paid AS (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'), top_users AS (SELECT user_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM paid GROUP BY user_id) SELECT * FROM top_users ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10;

content.tips: 递归 CTE 生成序列
content.content: WITH RECURSIVE seq AS (SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM seq WHERE n < 10) SELECT * FROM seq;

content.tips: 递归 CTE 查询层级结构
content.content: WITH RECURSIVE tree AS (SELECT id, name, parent_id FROM departments WHERE parent_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT d.id, d.name, d.parent_id FROM departments d JOIN tree t ON d.parent_id = t.id) SELECT * FROM tree;
WITH RECURSIVE subs AS (SELECT id, name, manager_id FROM employees WHERE id = 1 UNION ALL SELECT e.id, e.name, e.manager_id FROM employees e JOIN subs s ON e.manager_id = s.id) SELECT * FROM subs;

content.tips: EXISTS 判断存在（推荐大表）
content.content: SELECT * FROM users u WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id AND o.status = 'paid');
SELECT * FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT user_id FROM vip_list);
SELECT DISTINCT u.* FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.status = 'paid';
SELECT user_id, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS paid, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'refund' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS refund FROM orders GROUP BY user_id;
SELECT product_id, SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(created_at) = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS jan, SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(created_at) = 2 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS feb FROM orders GROUP BY product_id;
SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE status = 'active';
CREATE INDEX idx_cover ON orders(user_id, status, amount);
CREATE INDEX idx_name_prefix ON users(name(10));
SELECT * FROM orders FORCE INDEX (idx_user_id) WHERE user_id = 100;
EXPLAIN SELECT u.name FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.status = 'paid';
START TRANSACTION;
BEGIN;
COMMIT;
ROLLBACK;
SAVEPOINT sp1;
ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT sp1;
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ;
SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = 1 FOR UPDATE;

content.tips: 共享锁 LOCK IN SHARE MODE
content.content: SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = 1 LOCK IN SHARE MODE;
UPDATE products SET stock = stock - 1, version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1 AND version = 5;
UPDATE products SET stock = stock - 1 WHERE id = 1 AND stock > 0;
LOCK TABLES orders WRITE;
UNLOCK TABLES;
CREATE PROCEDURE get_user_orders(IN uid INT) BEGIN SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id = uid; END;

content.tips: 带输出参数的存储过程
content.content: CREATE PROCEDURE count_orders(IN uid INT, OUT total INT) BEGIN SELECT COUNT(*) INTO total FROM orders WHERE user_id = uid; END;
CALL get_user_orders(1);
DROP PROCEDURE IF EXISTS get_user_orders;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_user_log AFTER INSERT ON users FOR EACH ROW INSERT INTO user_logs(user_id, action) VALUES (NEW.id, 'created');
CREATE TRIGGER trg_order_audit BEFORE UPDATE ON orders FOR EACH ROW INSERT INTO order_history(order_id, old_status, new_status) VALUES (OLD.id, OLD.status, NEW.status);
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_user_log;
